title: 国产存储：估值应享溢价，全球同行会如何应对？
speaker: Leonid Miranov

segments.en: I mean, the market's obsessed over this, so there's a lot of information out there on the memory market. I like to think of it in sort of in buckets, right? And bucket number one about the general memory trade. And I think mostly, we've gotten the grips with memories likely to stay expensive for a while, but maybe it's not going to rip the new highs for the foreseeable future, right?
segments.zh: 市场对此非常关注，所以关于存储市场的信息很多。我喜欢把它分成几个部分。第一部分是整体存储交易。我认为我们基本已经认识到存储价格可能会在一段时间内保持高位，但在可预见的未来可能不会创出新高。

segments.en: And this kind of lenses in 10 to 12 X multiples for memory makers is quite reasonable, right? And then on top of it, you try and think, well, okay, but are there pockets of the memory space that are more or less interesting than others, right? So, more commoditized parts of the market, or the other way around, parts of the market that are more protected from competition, for example, right?
segments.zh: 因此，存储厂商10到12倍的估值似乎相当合理。然后在此基础上，你会想，存储领域是否有比其他部分更有趣或更无趣的部分？比如更商品化的部分，或者反过来，更受竞争保护的部分。

segments.en: And I think China, again, coming back to that point, Chinese DRAM market and HBM eventually is much more protected, right? Because it's not like companies can import a lot of the better chips, and it's not like domestic manufacturers could go to TSMC and fab as much as they like either, right?
segments.zh: 我认为中国，再次回到这一点，中国的DRAM市场和HBM最终会得到更多保护。因为公司无法大量进口更好的芯片，国内制造商也不能随意去台积电代工。

segments.en: And it's not like the domestic firms have capacity to fab anymore, right? So, all of a sudden, domestic supply demand bounds looks almost healthier than the rest of the world. Or, at the very least, you know that additional competition is going to struggle to come online, right?
segments.zh: 而且国内厂商也没有更多产能可以代工。因此，国内的供需关系看起来比世界其他地区更健康。至少，你知道新的竞争者很难进入。

segments.en: And so, I think this creates a fairly unique environment where domestic champions probably should be raising at the premium to the global levels because of what they represent, because they're not just a memory company because they are a symbol that domestically you can deliver on technology. I mean, it is really trading out of discount, right?
segments.zh: 因此，我认为这创造了一个相当独特的环境，国内龙头企业可能应该相对于全球水平享有溢价，因为它们代表的不仅仅是存储公司，更是国内技术能力的象征。实际上，它正在摆脱折价。
